newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 27 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 27 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated January 24 to commercial banks worth 27 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 24 billion pound at 13 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth three billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
Last week the Bank sold 60-day CDs worth eight billion pounds at 13 percent and made no sales of 45-day CDs at 12.25 percent.
